pages.title: Vent Crab
pages.text: $(thing)Vent Crab$(): A yeti crab: pale, hairy-clawed, walking the floor round the vents and waving its claws to feed the bacteria it farms on them. Harmless, unless struck. Near a vent long enough, it broods another. Found round the vents of Titan's hidden ocean.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Crab Chitin, Vent Biofilm.
